g.text: Each point compares one action with the same-block mean-EE reference
Pale region: positive weakest-link gain with actual mean-EE loss ≤10%. All points, including tails, are shown.
The 10% line evaluates execution outcomes; the algorithm constrains predicted loss. Crosses mark block QoS failures.
Asinh compresses the x-axis tails; tick labels retain actual percentages. Negative loss means mean EE increased.
